contentText: The UK police are looking for three suspects believed responsible for an overnight attack on ambulances belonging to a Jewish volunteer charity in London. No injuries were reported, but it is currently being treated as an antisemitic crime. The investigation is being led by the counter-terror officers, although it is not treated as a terrorist attack at this stage. Authorities say they are also looking into claims of responsibility made by a group online.
